purpose: Turn the existing delivery-readiness contract into a requestable Phase 0 handoff: official-data requests, human field-verification records, bounded reversible exercises and evidence close-out rules for future authorised parties.
claim_boundary: This action pack appoints no organisation and records no received official data, permission, budget, procurement, land right, site access, operating commitment, service agreement or approval. Every request starts not_received and every proposed exercise starts HOLD until the applicable authorised records exist.

data_requests.name_zh: 总体与重点区正式空间资料
data_requests.name_en: official overall and key-area spatial data
data_requests.required_payload: cleared SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA GIS/CAD/GeoJSON or archiveable plan files with publisher, version, publication date, coordinate reference system, permitted use and original-file hash
data_requests.if_not_received: Retain provisional_constraint geometry and do not make statutory, precise-area or construction-control claims.

data_requests.name_zh: 控规、道路与工程控制资料
data_requests.name_en: planning, access and engineering control data
data_requests.requested_from: relevant planning, transport, municipal, fire, property and operations interfaces
data_requests.required_payload: applicable control parcels, public-access and road conditions, utility and fire constraints, property/interface status, plus version, scope and reuse boundary
data_requests.if_not_received: HOLD parcel, height, demolition, road-line, engineering, fire, property and approval conclusions.

data_requests.requested_from: appointed human field-verification lead and affected interface custodian
data_requests.required_payload: dated, location-specific observations of legal passage, public entry, crossing, accessible alternative, shade/exposure, rest/water, lighting, service window and maintenance interface; each record identifies verifier, evidence reference, validity period and privacy handling
data_requests.if_not_received: Keep every affected node, route and service condition unknown or HOLD; AI cannot write or promote a field result.

data_requests.requested_from: heritage authority, park manager, property/interface custodian or other lawful approver
data_requests.required_payload: cleared protection geometry or scope, intervention limits, approved interpretation text and any attachment, lighting, excavation or sign-installation conditions
data_requests.if_not_received: Retain cultural narrative and non-intrusive interpretation only; do not start physical heritage intervention or installation.

data_requests.name_zh: 试点责任、资源、服务与数据治理文件
data_requests.name_en: pilot responsibility, resource, service and data-governance records
data_requests.requested_from: future authorised implementation, operations, data-governance and service parties
data_requests.required_payload: named accountable and stop-authority roles, lawful site/test permission, resource or procurement path, maintenance and service window, data source and privacy assessment, audit/log/appeal procedure, and optional compute or service agreement
unlocks: activation of an individual work-package card
data_requests.if_not_received: Keep the work package HOLD and do not describe a concept role, resource band or AI layer as an operating service.

field_record_protocol.record_owner: future appointed ROLE-02 authorised field-verification lead
field_record_protocol.privacy_boundary: Do not collect facial images, identity profiles, personal trajectories or uncleared data. Use location-specific evidence only to evaluate the declared public-service condition.
field_record_protocol.review_rule: A record may release only the gate it directly supports. Missing, stale, rejected or unauditable evidence retains HOLD, DOWNGRADE, REROUTE or STOP; no AI actor may change unknown to Verified.

minimum_reversible_exercises.purpose: At one confirmed public interface, test whether fixed bilingual information and human handover preserve the documented decision sequence when phone, screen and AI functions are unavailable.
minimum_reversible_exercises.evidence_output: dated walkthrough record, legibility observation, clearway sketch, human-handover result and close-out decision
minimum_reversible_exercises.stop_or_hold: HOLD before an authorised record exists; remove, relocate or downgrade any component that obstructs passage, cannot be read or lacks a maintainable human fallback.

minimum_reversible_exercises.name_zh: 公共绕行与测试停止演练
minimum_reversible_exercises.purpose: At a permitted and bounded future test interface, exercise stopping the test-facing layer while preserving a legible public bypass, physical information and human explanation.
minimum_reversible_exercises.evidence_output: authorised test-window and buffer record, stop decision, bypass observation, privacy boundary check and close-out decision
minimum_reversible_exercises.stop_or_hold: HOLD without lawful permission, buffer, public bypass, stop authority or privacy boundary; STOP immediately if testing affects public passage or safety.

minimum_reversible_exercises.name_zh: 到达与无障碍替代走查
minimum_reversible_exercises.purpose: At a confirmed public edge, document an arrival, legal crossing, accessible alternative, short stay and human-enquiry sequence without claiming unverified direct station access.
minimum_reversible_exercises.evidence_output: authorised route observation, access/crossing record, accessible-alternative assessment, unavailable-condition notice and close-out decision
minimum_reversible_exercises.stop_or_hold: HOLD without current legal-access and accessibility evidence; REROUTE to a verified public edge or suspend the continuity claim when the alternative fails.

required_contents: unresolved risks and current service statement
handover_packet.phase_rule: Phase 0 records evidence and interfaces. Phase 1 is limited to an authorised reversible exercise. Phase 2 requires the relevant professional review. Phase 3 requires sustainable responsibility, maintenance and auditable evidence.
handover_packet.promotion_boundary: Passing an exercise does not establish corridor-wide service, construction readiness, an approved plan or a Verified SLA promotion. Any promotion remains subject to the existing human evidence and independent review rules.
